title: IN WHICH CERTAIN INCIDENTS ARE NARRATED WHICH ARE ONLY TO BE MET WITH ON AMERICAN RAILROADS
summary_hover: Colonel Proctor forces Fogg into a duel aboard the train, but a sudden attack by Sioux warriors interrupts them.
summary_detail: As the train continues its journey across the American West, Colonel Proctor interrupts Fogg's whist game and demands a duel. Unable to stop at Plum Creek, they prepare to fight in the rear car. Before they can duel, a band of Sioux attacks the train. Passepartout heroically uncouples the cars to stop the train near Fort Kearney, but goes missing in the aftermath.
